items:
Hip hip hooray for ChardonYay! Enjoy the ultimate family vacation or couples getaway in this beautiful home with all the amenities. From the large front porch, you enter directly in to the spacious, open living room and kitchen. This bright, happy space looks out on your private pool and large pool deck. The kitchen is fully stocked with blender, cuisinart, toaster oven, Keurig, and all the pots, pans, and utensils you need for enjoying meals at home. Step out to the pool deck or unpack your bags in the large downstairs bedroom. This bedrooms features a queen size bed and updated ensuite bathroom.

Head upstairs to 1 of 2 master suites. The front of the house master features 2 balconies. One balcony overlooks the pool at Rosemary and one offers the perfect, quiet nook for enjoying that first cup of coffee in the morning. The master also includes a huge walk in closet, and large bathroom. Bathroom has his and hers sinks, private toilet, large shower and luxurious soaking tub. Also on the 2nd floor is additional master suite with large private balcony overlooking the private pool. This bedroom also has an en-suite bathroom.

The 3rd floor is dedicated to fun. The top floor features a spacious double bunk room and private bathroom. Kids will love having their own private level.

ChardonYay offers the perfect setting for your family vacation or adult getaway. Park your car when you arrive and walk or ride your bike everywhere. Activities abound at ChardonYay! Enjoy sunning on the large pool deck, swimming in the private, heated pool or wander down the palm lined promenade to the neighborhood's private beach. This strip of sugar white sand and beautiful, clear turquoise water won't disappoint!

Take a stroll or grab your bike and explore some of 30a's best neighborhoods right outside your door. Water's Edge is adjacent to Rosemary Beach and a few short blocks from Alys Beach making some of the finest restaurants on 30a just steps away. Take the kids for ice cream after dinner at Rosemary's Sugar Shack or ride to the donut truck every morning in Alys. Grab a beer and listen to acoustic guitar across the street at Peddlers. ChardonYay offers unparalleled convenience to enjoy the best of 30a!

Located just 20 minutes from Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport, servicing American, Delta, SouthWest, and United, an escape to the turquoise waters along 30a and the comforts of ChardonYay is easy!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
